data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for building custom pull-to-refresh effects quickly.
data.what_it_does: Provides PullToRefreshNotification and PullToRefreshContainer widgets to build customized pull-to-refresh headers, appbars, and animations in scrollable lists.
use_when: You want custom pull-to-refresh animations or headers beyond standard Material and Cupertino indicators
You need to handle pull-to-refresh states in a reverse list or custom scroll view
avoid_when: You only need standard, out-of-the-box Material or Cupertino refresh indicators
You do not use scrollable widgets
strengths: Highly customizable refresh headers and UI states
Supports reverse lists and custom scroll views
Cross-platform support including web and desktop
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of custom header UI instead of a plug-and-play indicator
